data.description:
## Context / Problem

Hidden CLI aliases remain in `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py:415-450,519-595` and `src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py:13,76-80`: `bridge-status`, `bridge-fsck`, `bridge-probe`, `jira-onboard`, and `verify-authorship`. Each has a canonical command over the same implementation owner.

## Approach

Delete these aliases and their compatibility help/docs/tests, retaining only the canonical routes: `bridge status`, `bridge fsck`, `bridge check-access`, `bridge setup`, and `verify-identity`. Record the pre-1.0 break. The `reconcile` family is deliberately excluded; it has its own dependency-ordered container.

## Scope

- CLI registry and parser/help aliases
- command references, examples, changelog, and CLI tests

## Testing

For each old spelling, assert parser rejection; for each canonical spelling, assert it reaches the existing owner and preserves exit behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Each of the five approved simple aliases is absent from the CLI registry, help, docs, and examples.
- [ ] The five canonical commands reach the same existing implementation owners and preserve their current outcomes.
- [ ] Old spellings fail at parsing before command execution.
- [ ] Changelog/release notes list each removed spelling and canonical replacement.
data.title: Remove approved simple CLI compatibility aliases
